**What were you auditing?**
System prompt / architecture description / codebase / mix — a sanitized excerpt is fine if the real one is sensitive.

**What did the skill report?**
Paste the relevant finding(s) or the whole report if short.

**What's wrong with it?**
- [ ] Missed a real structural risk that should have been caught
- [ ] Flagged something that isn't actually a problem (false positive)
- [ ] Report format didn't follow the template (missing section, no risk level, etc.)
- [ ] System Map didn't connect findings into a real causal chain
- [ ] Something else (describe below)

**Expected vs. actual**
What should the report have said instead?
